app.title: Roller Coaster Designer
app.tagline: Design a coaster by sculpting the forces you want riders to feel.
app.emptyHint: Start with File → New, File → Open, or File → Load Demo.
app.credits: By Jan Lienemann and Julian Dietsche. Builds on FVD++ by Stephan "Lenny" Alt and on KexEdit by IndividualKex.

menu.saveUnavailable: Your browser does not support in-place save. Use Save As… instead.
menu.exportFvdWarning: Some project details will be transformed or dropped on FVD export:
menu.prefsStub: A full preferences panel lands at M8 (units, theme, graph colours, mesh quality, playback defaults). For now, language is set via the switcher in the top-right.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.fvdCompatibilityHint: Match FVD++ 0.79 byte-for-byte on export. Disable for higher long-range precision.
prefs.integratorModeNote: Today this toggle controls FVD export bit-parity only. The live forces graph will honour it once the integrator merge lands (spec §5.6).
prefs.morePrefs: More preferences (units, theme, graph colours, mesh quality, playback defaults) arrive in M8.

scene.title: Scene
scene.floorTileHint: World metres per texture tile. Slider covers 0.5–50 m; numeric field accepts any positive value.
scene.colorHiddenByImage: Clear the image to pick a colour
scene.note: Images live in the browser tab and vanish on reload.

sections.empty: No sections yet. Start with New or Load Demo.
sections.fvdIncompatible: Will be transformed or dropped on FVD export

properties.empty: Select a section to edit its parameters.
properties.name: Name
properties.fDirectionHint: 0° = vertical loop (pitch up), 90° = level turn, 180° = pitch down. Intermediate values give helices and diving turns.
properties.heldVelocityHint: When on, the rider stays at this speed regardless of altitude — used for brake runs, station segments, and launch sections.
properties.nlCsvReadonly: NoLimits CSV sections are read-only in M3.
properties.bankingSyncHint: Copies the previous section's end banking into this section's start so the roll is continuous.
properties.bankingShortcutNote: Single Cubic transition from start to end. The full timeline editor (later) lets you stack multiple transitions.
properties.editSubfuncsHint: Open the full curve editor for roll / pitch / yaw rates.

subfunc.title: Subfunc editor
subfunc.clickToAdd: Click in empty space to add a boundary.
subfunc.dragBoundary: Drag a boundary line to move it.
